notes: Standard statics from 5 user references (2026-10-29): nurse, plus-size and Disney angles. Medical/body outcome claims in the refs (chest fat eliminated, snoring eliminated, unclog legs, thermal circulation, doctor-recommended seals, 'last 24 hours') replaced with shift/park-day timelines and the standard 40% offer + 30-day guarantee. No $120 strike-through used while the 40%-vs-50% question is open.

concepts.angle: Wear them for a 12-hour shift or your money back: hour 1 / hour 6 / hour 12 panels, same nurse, still standing
concepts.based_on: User reference: 'PEITOS MASCULINOS ELIMINADOS / MAIO JUNHO JULHO' three-stage ad (body-change claim replaced by a shift timeline) + nurse 'by hour 6' language
concepts.headline: 12-HOUR SHIFT TESTED
concepts.prompt: Light grey seamless background. Top: a solid black bar with heavy white all-caps "12-HOUR SHIFT TESTED", under it heavy black all-caps "OR YOUR MONEY BACK". Middle: three tall photo panels in a row of the same nurse in navy scrubs, shown from the knees down, standing on a hospital floor in the black-and-purple shoes from the product reference (sharp, correct, true proportions), each with a thin orange circle drawn around her shoes, and a heavy black all-caps label under each panel: "HOUR 1", "HOUR 6", "HOUR 12". In the first panel a wall clock reads 7:00, in the second 1:00, in the third 7:00 with a darker window. Bottom: a pair of the black-and-purple shoes from the product reference, large and sharp, beside a small white card with heavy black text "30-day money-back guarantee". All text is large, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+; nothing small or thin.

concepts.headline: This Will NOT Make Your Shift Shorter...
concepts.prompt: Moody dark blue photo of a quiet hospital break room at night, soft window light, a bench in the foreground. Top: small white text "For nurses on 12-hour shifts", then a big white serif headline on two lines "This Will NOT Make" / "Your Shift Shorter...". Center: a pair of the black-and-purple shoes from the product reference resting on the bench, large and sharp at true proportions, softly lit. Right, overlapping: a round dark navy badge with a thin silver ring, heavy white "40% OFF" and small white "TODAY". Below the shoes, white text "It'll just " + soft purple "feel" + white " that way." Bottom: small white text "30-day money-back guarantee". No seals, no certification badges, no doctor claims. All text is large, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+; nothing small or thin.

concepts.prompt: Solid black background. Top center: a white box with heavy black condensed all-caps "WALK DISNEY ALL DAY", under it heavy white all-caps "OR YOUR MONEY BACK". Below, three tall photo cut-outs in a row of the same woman's legs from the knees down in light capri pants, wearing the red/burgundy shoes from the product reference (sharp, correct, true proportions), each standing on a short patch of sunny theme-park pavement (no castles, no characters, no logos): the first in bright morning light, the second in midday sun, the third under warm evening string lights.
